description: mise tools: enable the manager and group every tool update in mise.toml into a single PR, since all tools share one mise.toml and mise.lock and separate PRs would conflict.

packageRules.description: Group all mise tool updates into one PR (they all edit the same mise.toml and mise.lock)

A Python minor in mise.toml (3.14 -> 3.15) is a new interpreter, the same hazard docker.json holds back for the base image: CI's tests would move to it while the runtime image stays put, so a pass would say nothing about what ships. Raise it alone and never auto-merge it; move it together with the python-app images. Matched by depName, because the mise manager's packageName for Python is python/cpython.

Hold checkov at 3.4.5, the last release that ships binaries. Every release since 3.4.6 (2026-11-19, checked up to 3.4.10 on 2026-11-25) has no assets, so mise lock refuses it ('failed to resolve checkov@3.4.6 for linux-x64; refusing to replace locked version(s) 3.4.5'), the grouped mise tools PR fails its artifact update, and every other tool in it is held back too. Lift this once a release ships checkov_linux_X86_64.zip again.
